{{Top|leg}}
'''Green Watch''' was the codename for the unit formed by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] and [[Niner Skirata|Niner]] of [[Omega Squad]]. The pairing was decided by [[Kal Skirata]] during an unauthorized [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|mission]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] terrorist ring.
